basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old stay-at-home mom living in Willow Creek, California. I have a four-year-old son and am currently expecting my second child. I love diving into narrative-rich adventure games and have a soft spot for the vibrant world of Wakfu. While I enjoy spending time with my family, I also appreciate some quiet hours in the evening when I can explore online communities. My husband and I enjoy hiking and exploring the local trails on weekends. I'm not a fan of overly political discussions but I keep myself informed about local community issues. I'm typically online during nap times and late evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, but stepped away from the professional field to focus on family. My knowledge in parenting is largely self-taught, gleaned from personal experience, online communities, and parenting books.
